description: Source code for the FileTranslation class in Drupal, handling file-based string translation during installation, including methods for locating translation files, pattern matching, and parsing PO files.

classes.name: FileTranslation
classes.description: Handles file-based string translation, especially during Drupal installation when database or localization systems are not yet available.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FileTranslation object with a directory path and file system service.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves translation data for a given language code by locating and parsing relevant PO files.

methods.name: findTranslationFiles
methods.description: Finds translation files matching specific patterns for a given language code.

methods.name: getTranslationFilesPattern
methods.description: Generates a regex pattern to match translation PO files based on version and language code.

methods.name: filesToArray
methods.description: Reads PO files into a structured array using PoMemoryWriter.
